The above Unaudited Consolidated Financial Results of DOMS Industries Limited ("the Holding Company" or "Parent"), its subsidiaries (collectively "the Group"), and one associate for the quarter and six months ended September 30, 2026 have been reviewed and recommended by the Audit Committee and approved by the Board of Directors at their meetings held on November 02, 2026.
3. The Holding Company completed its Initial Public Offer of 15,196,510 equity shares of face value Rs 10 each (comprising fresh issue and offer for sale), and its equity shares were listed on BSE Limited (BSE) and National Stock Exchange of India Limited (NSE) on December 20, 2023.
As at September 30, 2026, the entire net proceeds of Rs. 33,272.45 lakhs (revised from Rs. 33,157.50 lakhs during the year ended March 31, 2026, on account of lower-than-estimated issue expenses, with the resultant savings of Rs. 114.95 lakhs added to General Corporate Purposes) stand fully utilised in accordance with the objects stated in the Offer Document.
